Migration modal

Capability-based engine handoff

ara --json capabilities reports projectLayouts: [4]. Missing or invalid declarations mean v3-only. A v4 project is blocked before spawn with ARA1915; an old v3 project may still use its old engine. Migration pins the current engine in the same typed transaction. Explicit repinning waits for saved history and project bytes before opening.

Signed Install current handles an older same-version cohort through a dedicated confirmation and atomic managed replacement. It preserves external files and rollback authority. Ordinary Repair keeps its existing source-build check.
